subject: Prime deployment: intake & activation checklist
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@frostline.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Prime deployment: intake & activation checklist

Hi Alice,

Thanks for picking Redwood for the Prime deployment. To accelerate the onboarding and avoid last-minute blockers, attached is a focused intake checklist that covers the networking, KMS, and account-level prerequisites we need to validate before day‑zero.

Top asks (short):
- Confirm whether this will be VPC-hosted (cloud VPC peering) or fully on‑prem (air‑gapped) for the initial staging.
- Provide a contact for the infra engineer who can verify firewall/NAT rules and run a connectivity smoke test (bastion + egress).
- Confirm KMS/HSM approach (customer-managed KMS vs Redwood-managed) and key rotation cadence.
- Service account(s) / username that we should whitelist (we list the default names in the attachment).

I've attached: PRIME_Onboard_Checklist_v2.xlsx (checklist + answer columns) and a draft network diagram (network-diagram.png) you can annotate.

Can we do a 30‑minute pre‑flight call this Thursday 7/17 at 11:00 AM PT? If that doesn't work, send two windows you prefer.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: PRIME_Onboard_Checklist_v2.xlsx (Excel, 96KB)]
[Attachment: network-diagram.png (PNG, 1.2MB)]

From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@frostline.com>

Cc: procurement@frostline.com, it@frostline.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prime deployment: intake & activation checklist

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the checklist.

Answers inline/high level:
- Deployment mode: we want Redwood in a VPC-hosted model (private peering) for staging, with a plan to evaluate an on‑prem option for prod later this year.
- Infra contact: Ben Hsu (ben.hsu@frostline.com) — cc'd our IT alias (it@frostline.com).
- KMS: we must use customer-managed KMS (Azure Key Vault); procurement will share the KMS policy and SCIM roles. Key rotation is quarterly.
- Service accounts: we'll provide the list by EOD tomorrow.

Thursday 7/17 11:00 AM PT works for our infra lead. Please send a calendar invite and agenda.

Alice Wu
Director of Engineering
Frostline Therapeutics

Key action items for us before the pre‑flight call:
- Prepare VPC peering checklist: required CIDR ranges, allowed ports (443, 80, 22 for bastion only), NAT egress expectations, and SG examples.
- Confirm we can support Azure Key Vault customer-managed keys — flag potential caveat: HSM-backed KEK may require extra validation for edge connectors.
- Create JIRA INFRA ticket and assign to infra‑oncall for NAT/peering testing (propose JIRA:INFRA-1129).
- Draft minimal runbook for smoke test (bastion -> service endpoint, TLS validation, token exchange).

Ben: can you own the peering sample template and the smoke test script? I'll draft the KMS compatibility notes and Rack account mappings.
